$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Image tracer
blocks.note: Machine-neutral. An app that still carries its own copy of it should import it instead.
blocks.for: A picture into colour regions as shapes: decode, crop and adjust, remove the background, reduce the colours, trace the outlines.

blocks.name: SVG reader
blocks.for: Read an SVG file into shapes: what it contains first (colours, strokes, real size in mm), then the outlines, as normalised rings per colour (with outlines as lines to follow, for a laser or a pen) or as a one-colour legend in the file's own units. The SVG wizard shows its result.

internal.why: The image tracer's stages one at a time, for the tests and benches that measure each. An app traces with processImage.
